about: The tryaii design-partner questionnaire + consent tiers. The agent asks these conversationally (honoring ask_if) and shows each consent tier's copy VERBATIM. Answers are a flat {question_id: answer} object.

questions.prompt: What email should we use to reach you about the program?
What company or project is this for?
Which LLM providers do you use today?
Which OpenAI models do you use most?
Which Anthropic models do you use most?
Which Gemini models do you use most?
Which other providers/models do you use?
Which frameworks or gateways sit between your code and the models?
Roughly how many LLM calls per day across your systems?
Roughly what do you spend on LLM APIs per month?
Where is your LLM usage today?
How do you choose which model handles which task today?
How much effort have you put into making prompts cache-ready (stable prefixes, provider prompt caching)?

options.label: Aware of it, no time invested

questions.prompt: What's your biggest LLM pain right now - cost, quality, latency, something else?
Which tryaii capabilities interest you most?

options.label: routing - pick the best model per prompt
budget - dataset routing under a spend cap

questions.prompt: Open to a short follow-up call with the tryaii team?

consent_tiers.title: Contact only
includes: your contact details (name, email, company, role)
consent_tiers.copy: We will receive exactly what you typed into this questionnaire: your answers and your contact details. Nothing from your codebase, prompts, or diagnose runs is included. We will use your contact details only for the design-partner program.

consent_tiers.title: Summary insights
includes: your questionnaire answers and contact details
the redacted diagnose summary: check-status counts, cache-verdict counts, monthly cost/savings totals, and swap statistics
consent_tiers.copy: In addition to your questionnaire answers and contact details, we will receive the redacted summary of your latest diagnose run: how many call sites you have, counts of check outcomes and cache verdicts, and the estimated monthly cost and savings totals. This summary contains NO code, NO file paths, NO prompts, and NO free-text from you beyond the questionnaire - it is the aggregate numbers only.

consent_tiers.title: Full partnership
includes: your questionnaire answers and contact details
the FULL findings of your latest diagnose run: file paths, line numbers, model names, verdicts, recommendations, and prompt excerpts
the diagnose inventory: your ACTUAL PROMPTS, verbatim, as your agent collected them
consent_tiers.copy: In addition to your questionnaire answers and contact details, we will receive the complete findings AND the prompt inventory of your latest diagnose run. In plain words: this includes your repository file paths and line numbers, the model names you use, and YOUR ACTUAL PROMPTS - their full text, verbatim, including anything embedded in them. Choose this tier only if you are comfortable sharing that prompt content with the tryaii team. It gives us the deepest picture and you the most tailored partnership.
